body: ## Pull request overview Fixes conditional-format rendering so `status` meta variables (e.g., `$symbol`) are considered “present” based on their rendered output, which resolves mirrored symbol cases like `$symbol($symbol)`. **Changes:** - Update conditional rendering logic in `StringFormatter` to evaluate meta variables by their rendered segments (not just nested variable references). - Add formatter tests covering conditional meta variables that render to literal/styled text. - Add a `status` module regression test for mirrored `success_symbol` in a conditional segment. ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 2 out of 2 changed files in this pull request and generated 3 comments. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `src/formatter/string_formatter.rs` | Adjusts conditional-show logic for meta variables and adds regression tests for literal/styled meta output. | | `src/modules/status.rs` | Adds a regression test covering `$symbol($symbol)` rendering for success status. | --- 💡 Add Copilot custom instructions for smarter, more guided reviews.
